title: 第15章 这是中国功夫？第16章 扭捏的托马斯
content_zh:
第015章 这是中国功夫？
伍尔弗汉普顿打了一个完美的反击，王利完成了一次强势的一条龙进球！
观众席上的球迷们疯狂的讨论着刚才那粒进球，互相询问着场上那名叫艾伦的黑发小子的资料，这个突然冒出来的球员可是给了他们足够大的惊喜，这种惊喜现在已经演变为狂热！
“艾伦！！艾伦！！”他们疯狂的呼叫这王利的名字，来表达心中对他的赞美之情。
球迷中有个满脸胡须的白人大汉，正嬉笑的和他周围的人说着什么。
“嘿嘿，你们不知道吧，艾伦刚来伍尔弗汉普顿的时候，可是坐的我的出租车呢！”大汉说完便哈哈大笑，引来无数人关注的目光。
果然，听了这话，附近的球迷马上转过头去，带着询问的眼神看着他。
“跟你们说，他下车的时候，我找他要了一张签名呢，你们猜他说了什么？”停顿了一下，左右看了看，他有些炫耀的继续道：“他说‘这是我的第一个签名呢’，那张签名可是就在我房间的枕头下面，这次回去我要把它好好装裱起来挂在墙上。”
“哇，胡子，你运气可真好！”
“你真是太幸福的，一会我就堵在门口，一定向他要到第二张签名！”
......
此时，场上的王利却没心情去享受这些赞誉，经过刚才那次长途奔袭，他已经没剩多少体力了，而且身体中的内力也几乎枯竭了。
他半蹲在地上粗喘着气，想着一个问题：‘自已的体能实在太差了，内力修为也要加强，这也只是青年队的比赛而已。英超可不比青年队，对抗上完全不是一个档次，自己现在这种状态如果在英超的话，最多只能坚持半场而已。”
队员们围在王利附近，看到他的样子，也知道是体能消耗的太严重了，皮特.卡斯便对他说道：“艾伦，我看你还是下场吧，你的体力跟不上了，放心吧，我们一定会守住比分的，对吗伙计们？！！”
“恩！！”
王利点了点头，蹒跚的向替补席走去。老伍德笑了笑，他知道王利刚才这个进球已经是他最后的表演了，上半场大范围的跑动以及刚才的长途奔袭已经耗尽了他的体力。
换人，刚刚进球后，老伍德就用皮埃尔.克拉克替换下了王利。
“诶？伍德先生想让艾伦提前接受全场球迷的掌声，看来他的体力已经不多了，那么大家就把掌声献给伍尔弗汉普顿的舞蹈大师艾伦.王吧！”解说员适时的带动了球迷的热情。
观众席上一万多名球迷疯狂的鼓掌来欢送王利，他今天一传一射，完全引导了比赛的进程，使得伍尔弗汉普顿青年居然和曼联青年队打了个平分秋色，理应受此掌声。
王利下场之后，伍尔弗汉普顿的所有队员全都聚集到了后场，就连皮特和哈利尔森都回到了己方的半场，他们要全力守住剩余的几分钟。

面对众志成城、一心防守的伍尔弗汉普顿青年队，曼联青年也没有什么好办法，这种铁桶阵可不是这么短的时间能够攻破的，禁区内的足球根本没有办法通过由人肉铸成的钢铁战线...
最后的比分是2:2,伍尔弗汉普顿在最后几分钟追平了比分。
这时，全场观众已经彻底疯狂了，虽然只是平局，但对伍尔弗汉普顿的球迷来说，他们已经满足了，能和曼联青年队打成平手，这就是胜利。
曼联青年队的主教练保罗－麦克吉尼斯非常的郁闷，比赛就快要结束了，结果被对手追平了比分。不过，他却用闪亮的眼光看着伍尔弗汉普顿替补席上被众人举起的黑发小子，心中暗暗打定了主意。
......
比赛过后，王利便拉着托马斯径直的回到了宿舍，他实在太累了。但他却不知道的是，外面的记者们却已经吵翻了天。
现代社会的网络十分发达，信息传播速度是不可想象的，比赛才刚刚结束，英超联赛的各个俱乐部以及各种体育媒体几乎都已经知道伍尔弗汉普顿出现一个超级天才的消息，同时也拿到了这场比赛的录像。
各个俱乐部就要理智很多，至多也只是派出球探来观察而已，仅仅在一场青年队比赛表现突出的年轻人，并不能保证他的未来一定会成功，英格兰流星一般逝去的‘天才’多的数不胜数，谁也不敢保证这个黑发小子就不是。
而且，英超联赛却和青年队完全不在一个级别，每个英超联赛的球员，都可以称的上是青年队中的天才！
各个媒体可不管那么多，只要是能增加销量的消息，他们便会蜂拥而至，各地记者纷纷前往伍尔弗汉普顿进行采访。
但是，他们注定要失望了，因为王利现在已经在球员宿舍里休息了，要知道球员宿舍就在俱乐部内，他根本不用出俱乐部的门，也就是说他们根本不可能找到王利。
......
伍尔弗汉普顿俱乐部的一个球员宿舍内，王利盘膝做在床上，准备进入修炼状态，这样能快速的恢复今天的消耗。
不过，令他有些烦闷的是，今天的内力枯竭却导致了他几乎半个多月的内力修为付之东流，身体中的内力直接减少了三分之一...
怪不得前世虚竹子一直叮嘱他千万不要过多使用内力，小无相功虽然无色无相，修炼速度极快，威力也不错，但却有一个缺点－－当内力枯竭时，恢复的内力便会稀薄很多...
幸好只是少了半个多月的内力，如果自己已经修习了二十年，无法想象当发现内力居然少了三分之一时，自己会不会直接跳楼自杀...
“喂，艾伦，我一直有个问题想问你，你每天晚上都做着这个动作睡觉，这样有什么好处吗？难道能增加Xing能力？”托马斯一脸疑惑的问道，他想问这件事很久了，不过他的想法实在有些...，要是让那些少林高僧们知道英格兰有个托马斯这么评价他们的修炼方式，也许他们会集体坐飞机来伍尔弗汉普顿教训他...
听了之后，王利也满脸冷汗，随意的答道：“这个是修炼内力...算了，这么说你也不明白，这个就是练习中国功夫，懂了吗？”
“中国功夫？”说着，他还摆了个李小龙的姿势，“是不是这种？你会中国功夫？”
王利无奈的点了点头。

“太好了，我最喜欢中国功夫了，以后有时间一定要教教我，等我学会中国功夫以后，随便耍上几手，肯定会迷倒一大群美丽的少妇的...”托马斯满脸淫笑的又陷入了幻想之中...
只是，王利可不会真把自己的功法传授给他，这个满脑子**思想的室友绝对会玷污了逍遥派的，而且他的内功心法可是他的底牌呢...;
content_en:
Chapter 015 Is this Chinese Kung Fu?
Wolverhampton made a perfect counterattack, and Wang Li completed a strong one-stop goal!
The fans in the audience were discussing the goal just now and asking each other about the information of the black-haired boy named Allen on the field. This sudden appearance of the player gave them a big surprise. This surprise has now turned into a frenzy!
"Alan!! Allen!!" They called Wang Li's name frantically to express their praise for him.
Among the fans was a big white man with a beard, who was laughing and talking to the people around him.
"Hehe, don't you know, when Alan first came to Wolverhampton, he took my taxi!" The big man laughed loudly after saying this, attracting the attention of countless people.
Sure enough, after hearing this, the nearby fans immediately turned their heads and looked at him with questioning eyes.
"Let me tell you, when he got off the car, I asked him for an autograph. What do you think he said?" He paused, looked around, and continued with some show-off: "He said, 'This is my first autograph.' That autograph is under the pillow in my room. This time I will frame it and hang it on the wall."
"Wow, Beard, you are so lucky!"
"You are so happy. After a while, I was blocking the door, trying to get a second autograph from him!"
...
At this time, Wang Li on the field was not in the mood to enjoy these praises. After the long-distance run just now, he didn't have much physical strength left, and the internal energy in his body was almost exhausted.
He squatted on the ground and panted heavily, thinking about a problem: 'My physical fitness is really poor, and my internal strength needs to be improved. This is just a youth team game. The Premier League is no better than the youth team, and the level of confrontation is completely different. If I were in the Premier League in this state, I would only be able to last for half a game at most. "
The team members gathered around Wang Li. Seeing his appearance, they knew that his physical energy was too much. Peter Cass said to him: "Alan, I think you should get off the field. Your physical strength can't keep up. Don't worry, we will definitely keep the score, right guys?" ! ! "
"kindness! ! "
Wang Li nodded and staggered towards the bench. Old Wood smiled. He knew that Wang Li's goal just now was his last performance. The wide range of running in the first half and the long-distance attack just now had exhausted his energy.
Substitution, just after scoring, Old Wood replaced Wang Li with Pierre Clark.
"Eh? Mr. Wood wants Alan to accept the applause from all the fans in advance. It seems that his energy is running out, so let’s give the applause to Wolverhampton’s dance master Alan Wang! "The commentator aroused the enthusiasm of the fans in a timely manner.
More than 10,000 fans in the audience applauded wildly to bid farewell to Wang Li. He completely guided the course of the game with one pass and one shot today, which made Wolverhampton Youth evenly matched with Manchester United Youth Team. He deserves this applause.
After Wang Li came off the field, all Wolverhampton players gathered in the backcourt. Even Peter and Harrelson returned to their own half. They had to defend the remaining minutes with all their strength.
Facing the Wolverhampton youth team who are united and dedicated to defense, the Manchester United youth have no good solution. This kind of iron barrel formation cannot be broken in such a short time. There is no way for the football in the penalty area to pass through the steel front made of human flesh...
The final score was 2:2, with Wolverhampton tying the score in the final minutes.
At this time, the audience was completely crazy. Although it was only a draw, for the Wolverhampton fans, they were satisfied. Being able to draw with the Manchester United youth team was a victory.
ManPaul McGuinness, the head coach of the United Youth Team, was very depressed. The game was almost over and the opponent tied the score. However, he looked at the black-haired boy being lifted up by everyone on the Wolverhampton bench with shining eyes, and secretly made up his mind.
...
After the game, Wang Li took Thomas straight back to the dormitory. He was too tired. But what he didn't know was that the reporters outside were already making a scene.
The Internet in modern society is very developed, and the speed of information dissemination is unimaginable. The game has just ended. Almost every club in the Premier League and various sports media have already heard about the emergence of a super genius in Wolverhampton, and they have also obtained the video of the game.
Each club needs to be more rational. At most, they only send scouts to observe. Just a young man who performs well in a youth team game does not guarantee that he will be successful in the future. There are countless 'geniuses' who have passed away like meteors in England, and no one can guarantee that this black-haired boy will not be the same.
Moreover, the Premier League is not at the same level as the youth team. Every Premier League player can be called a genius in the youth team!
The various media outlets don't care so much. As long as there is news that can increase sales, they will swarm in. Reporters from all over the world go to Wolverhampton for interviews.
However, they are destined to be disappointed, because Wang Li is already resting in the players' dormitory. You must know that the players' dormitory is within the club, and he does not need to go out of the club at all, which means that it is impossible for them to find Wang Li.
...
In a player dormitory of Wolverhampton Club, Wang Li was sitting cross-legged on the bed, preparing to enter a state of cultivation so that he could quickly recover from today's consumption.
However, what made him a little annoyed was that today's internal energy depletion caused almost more than half a month of internal energy cultivation to be wasted, and the internal energy in his body was directly reduced by one-third...
No wonder Xu Zhuzi in his previous life always told him not to use too much internal energy. Although the small phaseless skill is colorless, very fast to practice, and powerful, it has a shortcoming - when the internal energy is exhausted, the recovered internal energy will be much thinner...
Fortunately, I only lost more than half a month of internal energy. If I had been practicing for twenty years, I couldn't imagine whether I would jump directly to commit suicide when I found that my internal energy was missing by one-third...
"Hey, Alan, I've always had a question for you. Are there any benefits to doing this to sleep every night? Can it increase sexual ability?" Thomas asked with a puzzled look on his face. He had wanted to ask this for a long time, but his idea was... If those Shaolin monks knew that there was a Thomas in England who commented on their cultivation method, maybe they would fly together to Wolverhampton to teach him a lesson...
After hearing this, Wang Li also had a cold sweat on his face and replied casually: "This is about cultivating internal strength... Forget it, you don't understand even if you say so, this is about practicing Chinese Kung Fu, do you understand?"
"Chinese Kung Fu?" As he spoke, he also posed like Bruce Lee, "Is that this? Do you know Chinese Kung Fu?"
Wang Li nodded helplessly.
"Great, I like Chinese Kung Fu the most. I must teach it to me when I have time in the future. After I learn Chinese Kung Fu, I will definitely enchant a large group of beautiful young women by doing a few tricks..." Thomas said with a lewd smile on his face and fell into fantasy again...
However, Wang Li will not really teach him his skills. This roommate full of ** thoughts will definitely taint the Xiaoyao sect, and his internal skills and mental skills are his trump card...;
